BiblicalUsage: Devils are what Israel sacrificed to when it forgot God. Moses sings that they sacrificed unto devils, not to God, to gods whom they knew not, and the psalm says they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils. The word is blunt: the worship was real, and its object was not the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe idolatry always has a real object, even when it is called nothing, for Israel's sacrifices went somewhere, and I hold that every false god still takes its payment in lives.
